scope: All eight stages of the shared three-parameter synthetic-truth solution.
time_definition: Elapsed simulation seconds; piecewise linear interpolation between stored output rows, not dense integrator interpolation.

tg.definition: Condensed mass / initial dry mass, dimensionless; includes liquid and mineral-bound mass, excludes stored pore gas. Not mass divided by initial wet mass.

dsc.definition: Net thermal boundary power / initial dry mass in W/kg, positive inward/endothermic. No additional reaction heat or gas-carried enthalpy is added; not instrument-specific DSC.

dilatometry.definition: Negative arithmetic mean axial thickness shrinkage, dimensionless; initial cell widths are equal. Reference is the model initial cell bulk volume, not isotropic linear strain.

kiln.definition: Prescribed reservoir temperature in K at elapsed simulation seconds; distinct from surface and cell-center temperatures.

liquid_water.definition: Total condensed liquid-water mol inventory times molar mass / initial total dry mass in kg/kg; excludes pore vapor and mineral-bound water; not maximum cell moisture.

surface_temperature.definition: Outer-boundary temperature in K from the half-cell conduction and convection/radiation relation; distinct from outermost cell-center and furnace values.

absorption.definition: Final cooled proxy connectivity * porosity * water density / bulk density in kg/kg; not measured absorption.

strength.definition: Final cooled proxy dense strength * exp(-porosity coefficient * porosity) in Pa; not measured strength.

defects.definition: Proxy 1-exp(-peak temperature span / gradient scale), dimensionless; not a measured defect rate.

mapping_threshold_source: Existing numerics.atol on errors normalized by each root calibration.scale; no new tolerance.
limitations: Same-solution mapping and arithmetic only. No material measurement, DSC instrument model, surface sensor placement validation or proxy-product qualification.

truth_audit_retention.limitation: First full-cycle truth is supported by actually recorded summary diagnostics only. No reconstructed or separately rerun full truth budget. Final fitted forward mass/element/energy budgets, free-water ledger, thermodynamics, state domain and dimension check are retained by fit. The existing fit output does not retain the top-level gas-species ledger; this P06 run does not independently qualify that ledger.
